verdict.rationale: The release notes show a first-party OCI Generative AI service that can host imported open models such as zai-org/GLM-5.3, so managed inference over open models exists in some form. The evidence covers only a single region-specific model import, and the generic REST API docs do not specifically describe an inference API. Missing for 10: evidence of frontier/proprietary model availability, documented inference API endpoints for Generative AI, a breadth of managed model catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API

citations.quote: You can now import the zai-org/GLM-5.3 model into OCI Generative AI in the UAE Central (Abu Dhabi) region
